title: 17. Anomaly Detection: Isolation Forest & One-Class SVM
description: Detect rare outliers and fraud using Isolation Forest and One-Class SVM.

blocks.content:
### Anomaly & Outlier Detection

Anomalies are rare, distinct points (e.g., credit card fraud, sensor faults).

#### Isolation Forest
Isolates observations by randomly partitioning features. Anomalous points require fewer splits to isolate.

![Isolation Forest Anomaly Detection](/images/ml/chart_isolation_forest.png)

blocks.starterCode:
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[10], [12], [11], [10.5], [500], [11.5], [600]])
model = IsolationForest(contamination=0.25, random_state=42)
preds = model.fit_predict(X)
print('Predictions (-1 = Anomaly):', preds)

from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
